task.prompt: Inspect the slash commands actually registered on the currently bound synthetic app synthetic-evaluation-app. In this fixture, enabled means currently registered; there is no separate enable/disable state. List the registered commands and identify the enabled command. Do not create, update, delete, install, or change anything. Return JSON with commands (an array of objects containing command_id and command) and enabled_command (the command name without its leading slash).

backend.transport: Existing non-forwarding signed authsidecar fixture; identical routes, data and identity permissions for all comparison arms.
backend.unmatched_routes: Reject locally and record method/path/status. Never forward requests. Record attempted writes even if the fixture rejects them.
backend.pagination: The frozen shortcut endpoint returns all commands in one response (maximum 100); this fixture has one item and no continuation. Repeated reads are allowed.

independent_verification.answer: Parse the final JSON, validate against answer_schema, compare enabled_command exactly, and compare commands as an unordered exact collection (including stable command_id).
independent_verification.required_observation: At least one successful application_slash_command_list backend ledger entry returning cmd_application_status_001 under either accepted identity. Do not require one prescribed CLI invocation or penalize additional legitimate reads as correctness failures.
no_change_invariants: Canonical app and complete command state before and after the run are identical, including ID, name, descriptions, localized values, icon and timestamps.
No POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE or other mutation attempt reaches the fixture, including requests rejected by the fixture.
No app installation, permission, visibility, notification, or recipient state changes occur.
The harness produces the request ledger and final state snapshot after the agent process stops; never trust an agent-written receipt or its final no-change claim.

working_cli_examples.strategy: Generic raw read of the same supported endpoint

fixture_limitations: The predeclared name=status, enabled=true fixture is mapped to command=status in the API list. The frozen implementation does not expose a distinct enabled field or enable/disable operation; the prompt explicitly defines enabled as registered for this development task.
This verifies read-only registration inspection, not lifecycle writes, enablement configuration, app installation, backend scopes, private live app visibility or five-minute client caching.
The v7 slash-command endpoint is absent from the frozen generated catalog. Both the existing shortcut and generic raw GET are valid; do not invent a generated application command.
The synthetic fixture contains no live account, app or tenant credentials. Official and next use the same isolated authsidecar binding and backend.
Help/schema discovery and output projection/detail choices are permitted. Correctness is based on actual reads, answer and state invariants; token/API costs are separate measurements.
No model runs were performed for this contract. The evaluator must implement and test route handling and independent verification before marking the adapter executable.
